gwt.given: A shard-write delegate compiled with validateKey true for a model whose ShardKey property decodes to shard 3, record 100; the grain identity passed in decodes to shard 3, record 200.
gwt.when: The compiled delegate executes against that grain identity and model.
gwt.then: OrleansExpressionHelper throws OrleansIdKeyMismatchException naming the grain type, because the value decoded from the grain identity (record 200) does not equal the model's own ShardKey value (record 100).
